name: Corner Shop
intro: A corner shop. The kind that never closes and never has change.

pages: One BLUE. The flavour is blue. Nobody knows more than that.
It tastes like the colour. Don't think about it.

people.name: SHOPKEEPER
talk: We're always open. The sticker says 24/7. I wanted 24/7/365.25. The printer said no.
The camera? The Registry insists. It films the till.
The till has nothing to hide. The till has nothing at all, most nights.
Buy something or keep the cat company. The cat charges less.

people.name: CUSTOMER
talk: They moved the cheap noodles to the top shelf.
Top shelf is for people with legs.so. I have the free legs.
I come in to read the labels. It is warmer than the library and the library closed.

people.name: CUSTOMER
talk: Batteries. Two packs. Do not make it weird.
People ask what I do for fun. I queue. I am very good at it. I have never once been served first.
